annotations.text: Home page, full scroll. Evolves the August prototype: same paint-vs-ink brand system, larger type and photography, one entrance reveal on load.
The meeting date (strip, hero, praktisch) is computed live on the real site. Shown here as a sample: dinsdag 15 september.
Blog: archive cards on top, one full post below the dashed seam. Card copy is sample; the real archive has 17 posts.
Contact and FAQ shown close-up. These two sections carry the most interaction. FAQ answers are managed by the club as ordinary posts.
